aboutTeaser: I build the systems I needed when I was starting out — clear intake, honest measurement, and room for people to grow into them.

hero.subtitle: Balancing Process Improvement & People Development
hero.headline: I live between business language and technical language: rigorous enough to understand the technical side, fluent enough to translate it for any audience.
hero.lede: Most companies fix the system or the people. I build for both. I default to building systems. Banking, logistics, food-tech, construction — different industries, same problem: things breaking the moment they scale.
hero.tagline: Use the data. Keep the human visible.

startHere.title: People & talent
startHere.text: Recruiting systems, sourcing, and measurement. 10,000+ CVs a year through one intake gate; hiring turnaround down 80%.

startHere.title: Operations
startHere.text: Where the work breaks when it scales, I rebuild the flow. Tools-agnostic: intake to scorecards to dashboards — Sheets to SQL, whatever the team runs.

startHere.title: Consulting & Building
startHere.text: Reframe first, recommend with evidence, then build the system that makes it stick. I check the mechanism underneath before trusting the story on top.
